voolkan.options.about: voolkan is an unofficial fork of VulkanMod by xCollateral, licensed under the LGPL-3.0. This button opens the upstream author's Ko-fi page; the money goes to the VulkanMod project, not to voolkan.
vulkanmod.options.advCulling.tooltip: Use a culling algorithm that might improve performance by reducing the number of non visible chunk sections rendered.
vulkanmod.options.ao.subBlock.tooltip: Enables smooth lighting for non full block (experimental).
vulkanmod.options.entityCulling.tooltip: Enables culling for entities on not visible sections.
vulkanmod.options.frameQueue.tooltip: Higher values might help stabilize frametime but will increase input lag. 1 gives the lowest input lag but the CPU and GPU no longer overlap.
vulkanmod.options.lowLatency.tooltip: Waits for the GPU to finish the previous frame before reading input. Lower input lag, lower framerate when the GPU is the bottleneck.
vulkanmod.options.swapChainImages.toolti: Number of images the driver may queue for presentation. Fewer images mean less input lag, more images smooth out frametime. Clamped to what the display supports.
vulkanmod.options.backfaceCulling.toolti: Culls not visible block faces on the CPU improving GPU performance. To prevent increased CPU overhead enable Indirect Draw.
vulkanmod.options.indirectDraw.tooltip: Reduces CPU overhead but might increase GPU overhead.
vulkanmod.options.uniqueOpaqueLayer.tool: Use a unique render layer for opaque terrain to improve performance.
vulkanmod.options.wayland.tooltip: Use Linux Wayland compositor if available (Experimental). Requires restart.
voolkan.options.preset.tooltip: Stages a set of values in the options. Check them, then press Apply (or Undo to drop them).
voolkan.options.compat.renderPath.toolti: Read-only. Which Vulkan rendering API is in use: dynamic rendering, or the legacy render pass path for GPUs without VK_KHR_dynamic_rendering.
